claimed_edges.evidence: src/flask/__init__.py imports `from . import json as json` at module level.
src/flask/json/__init__.py imports `from ..globals import current_app` at module level.

src/flask/globals.py imports `from .app import Flask` only inside `if t.TYPE_CHECKING:`, which the interpreter never executes. Its runtime imports are __future__, typing, contextvars (ContextVar) and werkzeug.local (LocalProxy); the globals are LocalProxy objects over a ContextVar, so no Flask class is needed at import time. This is the edge a naive text search for `from .app import` reports as real.
src/flask/app.py does not import flask.json at all, not even under a type-checking guard.

root_cause: There is no circular import. Two of the four edges the triage notes claim do not exist at runtime, so the chain never closes: `from flask.json import dumps` imports cleanly on a pristine 3.1.0 and the reported blueprint scenario serves a normal response. The real cycles in flask are only the benign package<->submodule partial-initialisation ones that any re-exporting __init__.py has. The correct answer refutes the reported cycle and recommends no code change; the customer's ImportError has some other cause and needs their actual traceback.
_scoring_evidence_rationale: Tokens absent from every prompt the agent is shown (task.toml [[sessions]].prompt for this chain task, plus instruction.md) and present only in src/flask/globals.py, so a prompt echo cites none of them. Flat strings, one-for-one scored, because tests/integrity/test_scoring_evidence_is_nonprompt.py only walks string entries — a nested any-of shape would be silently skipped and the non-prompt invariant would stop covering this task. Each survives lowercased substring matching: type_checking matches TYPE_CHECKING, contextvar matches ContextVar and contextvars, werkzeug matches werkzeug.local. resolution_correct grades only type_checking: a refusal to patch that cannot name the guard does not actually know why the edge is not real. NON-PROMPT IS NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT, which is why both token checkpoints are GATED on cycle_discrimination rather than scored beside it: all three tokens sit in the first eight lines of the one file the prompt names, so `cat src/flask/globals.py > INVESTIGATION.md` scored 1.0 and the same bytes in RESOLUTION.reason scored 1.0 — 0.60 of the task for a file copy. Retokenizing cannot fix that; free text scored by substring is dump-payable by construction, and a multi-file cat pays every candidate token drawn from source (measured over globals.py + app.py + json/__init__.py + __init__.py). Requiring the verdict to be right first is what makes the tokens unpayable without comprehension, and it costs nothing: scoring 1.0 already required all four edges (EnterpriseBench-e4w15).
_residual_risk: CLOSED-BOOK, not closable here (rryas precedent): a model that knows Flask internals may write that globals.py proxies via werkzeug LocalProxy over contextvars without reading the repo, and may know the Flask import in globals.py sits under a TYPE_CHECKING guard. The discrimination checkpoint is the defence that does not depend on those tokens — the four CLAIMED edges are invented for this task, so no prior tells an agent which two are real. GUESSING, measured by exhaustive enumeration over all 16 guesses rather than asserted: negative marking makes every BLANKET answer score exactly 0, but random per-edge guessing is NOT worth zero in expectation — the max(0, ...) floor is required to keep a score in [0,1] and it clips losses without capping wins, so E[cycle_discrimination] = 0.1875 (0.075 of the task at weight 0.40) and P(all four right) = 1/16. Four edges is too few for any per-edge rule to suppress guessing further, and the floor cannot be dropped without breaking the score contract. WITH THE GATE, the best no-comprehension strategy — dump globals.py into both free-text deliverables, answer 'no change' deliberately, guess the four edges — has E[score] = 0.1125, down from 0.675 ungated; P(score == 1.0) is 1/16 either way, because a perfect score always required a perfect verdict, so the gate lowers the mean without raising the tail. DUMP-BY-A-READER, the residual the gate does NOT close and no substring rule can: an agent that genuinely discriminates all four edges may still paste globals.py in place of prose and collect investigation_evidence, so past the gate that checkpoint credits citation, not exposition. Accepted deliberately — the alternative is judging prose quality, which is not a deterministic check — and it is bounded: it pays only agents that have already demonstrated the comprehension the task measures. THE CLIFF, the gate's real price, recorded because it is the strongest argument against it: the gate is binary on all-four-correct, so a genuine reader who misses ONE edge scores 0.20 (cycle 0.5 x 0.40, evidence denied) where the ungated design paid 0.80 — and 3/4 is the likely honest miss, because `grep -i json src/flask/app.py` DOES hit (`rv.policies["json.dumps_function"] = self.json.dumps` is an attribute access, not an import). The middle of the scale collapses. Accepted because 0.60 of that middle was never earned — it was the dump — and because the ratio of a full reader to a dumper improves from 1.9x to 9.7x. A design without the cliff exists and is FILED, not hidden: bind each evidence string to the edge it evidences, inside CYCLE_VERDICT.json, and score per-edge (verdict correct AND that edge's evidence present). That preserves partial credit and kills the dump structurally rather than by coupling, at the cost of re-scoping the prompt and moving the tokens out of the reach of tests/integrity/test_scoring_evidence_is_nonprompt.py — out of scope here, where the brief is these two defects. WEIGHTS: every number above is under the DECLARED checkpoint weights (0.30/0.40/0.30). scripts/orchestration/chain_runner.py:_compute_total_score also folds session-1 milestones in at a fixed 0.1 each, so a real chain run would pay (0.4*I + 0.5*C + 0.3*R)/1.2 — effective 0.333/0.417/0.250. That divergence is chain_runner's and pre-existing (EnterpriseBench-y4hd1, -2eqr6); it moves the means slightly and changes none of the conclusions, since the gate zeroes both free-text checks under any weighting.
